cards.text: Jeremiah, the LORD's prophet, has just stood in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and announced that the LORD is about to bring disaster on Jerusalem (Jeremiah 19:14-15). Pashhur the priest, son of Immer, is the chief official in the house of the LORD. And he hears Jeremiah prophesying these things.

cards.question: Pashhur, the chief official in the house of the LORD, hears Jeremiah's message of disaster. What does Pashhur do to Jeremiah?

answers.text: Has him beaten and put in the stocks
Asks him to pray for the whole city
Brings him before the elders to explain

cards.text: Beaten, then locked in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, right by the house of the LORD. I think this one hurts, friend.
Jeremiah stays stuck there until the next day, when Pashhur lets him out of the stocks.

cards.question: Fresh out of the stocks, Jeremiah speaks to Pashhur. What does Jeremiah do?

answers.text: Gives him a new name from the LORD
Thanks him for letting him go free
Promises to stop prophesying there

cards.text: Jeremiah tells him, “The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.” The Millers carved my name on my handle with love, but I don't think Pashhur's gonna love this new name one bit.

cards.question: Jeremiah explains Pashhur's new name with what the LORD says. The LORD will make Pashhur a ___ to himself and to all his friends.

answers.text: terror
blessing
warning

cards.text: Then the LORD says Pashhur's friends will fall by the sword of their enemies, before his very eyes. That's a heavy one.

cards.question: The LORD's message reaches past Pashhur to the whole land. The LORD says He will hand Judah over to the king of ___.

answers.text: Babylon
Egypt
Assyria

cards.text: The LORD says the king of Babylon will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword. Then the LORD turns to everything the city owns.

cards.question: The LORD talks about all the wealth of Jerusalem, even the treasures of the kings of Judah. What does the LORD say will happen to it?

answers.text: Enemies will carry it all off
It will be buried under the temple
It will go to the poor of Judah

cards.text: The LORD says the products, the valuables and the kings' treasures will all be plundered, seized and carried off to Babylon. Like the movers showing up, packing EVERYTHING you own, and driving it to somebody else's house.
Then the LORD comes right back around to Pashhur himself.

cards.question: The LORD says Pashhur and everyone who lives in his house will go into captivity.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Once Pashhur is carried off, what does the LORD say will happen to him there?

answers.text: He will die and be buried there
He will rise to serve the king
He will escape and come home

cards.question: The LORD says Pashhur has been prophesying the truth to his friends all along.

answers.text: True
False
